agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 10, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated January 10, 2013. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated January 10, 2013 in the total amount of $4,542,836.42.
B.
Successor Agency dated January 10, 2013. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated January 10, 2013 in the total amount of $10,386,094.01.
8.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting and Cerritos Public Financing Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 13, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/FINANCING AUTHORITY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes and the Cerritos Public Financing Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 13, 2012.
End of Consent Calendar
9.
Public Hearings
A.
A proposal by Select Comfort Corporation on behalf of the property owner to remodel the interior and exterior of the existing commercial building and to refurbish he existing landscape on the property located at 11400 South Street, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned Regional Commercial (CR) (APN 7039-021-017). (COUNCIL) Precise Plan 78-13(A)(2012) Amendment* *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
approve Precise Plan 78-13(A)(2012) Amendment, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Plannign Commission Resolution No. 2012-35.
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and approval of a tri-party completion agreement between the Successor Agency to the City of Cerritos Redevelopment Agency, Great American Insurance Company and Sea West Enterprises, Inc. with respect to the Cerritos Sheriff's Station expansion, Project No. 72103, Bid No. 1081-09, for the correction of exterior stone veneer panels, in satisfaction of Performance Bond No. 5457192. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
ratify and approve a Tri-Party Agreement between the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency, Great American Insurance Company and Sea West Enterprises, Inc. with respect to the Cerritos Sheriff's Station Expansion, Project No. 72103, Bid No. 1081-09, for the correction of exterior stone veneer panels, in satisfaction of Performance Bond No. 5457192.
B.
Consideration of the City of Cerritos' Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for fiscal year 2011-12.
Consideration of the former Cerritos Redevelopment Agency's basic financial statements for the seven months ended January 31, 2012.
Consideration of the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency's basic financial statements for the five months ended June 30, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
COUNCIL -
1. receive and file the Fiscal Year 2011-12 City of Cerritos Comprehensive Annual Financial Report; and
2. receive and file the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Basic Financial Statements for the Seven Months Ended January 31, 2012.
SUCCESSOR AGENCY -
1. receive and file the Basic Financial Statements fo rthe Five Months Ended June 30, 2012 for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency.
11.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
13.
Adjournment
RECESS
RECONVENE
